scope: Independent-connection local MariaDB compatibility labs; not exact MySQL8.4/provider, deadlock, crash, backup restoration, RPO/RTO or application authorization verification

cases.name: READ COMMITTED initial
cases.details: A establishes its ordinary consistent-read observation.

cases.name: READ COMMITTED after committed B update
cases.details: B autocommits an update between A ordinary reads.

cases.name: REPEATABLE READ initial
cases.details: A establishes its ordinary consistent-read observation.

cases.name: REPEATABLE READ after committed B update
cases.details: B autocommits an update between A ordinary reads.

cases.name: COMMIT initial locking read
cases.details: A locks the complete unique-key row.

cases.name: COMMIT B waits
cases.details: B has not produced the selected value while A holds the conflicting lock; A later closes the transaction.

cases.name: COMMIT B sees released row
cases.details: The current locking read observes the state after A COMMIT.

cases.name: ROLLBACK initial locking read
cases.details: A locks the complete unique-key row.

cases.name: ROLLBACK B waits
cases.details: B has not produced the selected value while A holds the conflicting lock; A later closes the transaction.

cases.name: ROLLBACK B sees released row
cases.details: The current locking read observes the state after A ROLLBACK.

cases.name: Pending decrement observed
cases.details: Synthetic rollback example only; not a crash/restore test.

cases.name: Rollback restores quantity
cases.details: Rollback reverses the supported pending decrement.
